findings.title: Whitespace-only titles are accepted as valid
findings.explanation: The function now checks `if not title:` to enforce a required title, but it no longer strips surrounding whitespace. A title consisting only of spaces (e.g., "   ") is non‑empty, so it passes the required check and is stored, effectively allowing an empty‑looking title. This may violate the intended "title is required" constraint.
